overall_reason: Two colour systems run side by side, a shadcn role set and a large Untitled-UI-style set (466 colour tokens, 137 never referenced), and the page shows it as near-duplicate inks, muted greys, greens and borders.

score.reason: T-FRAMEWORK-FIT fails on the parallel token sets (TOK-011) and T-DRIFT-PAIRS on four near-duplicate colour pairs (TOK-010); radius and spacing pass T-SCALE-FIT.

findings.where: hero title, wordmark, hero lead, footer links, eyebrows; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: frameworks shows shadcn roles (20 of 20) beside a Tailwind v4 theme layer of 213 tokens with --color-text-primary, --background-color-* and --color-utility-* names. The h1 (#hero-title) renders #32302c while the wordmark and the chart labels (text.fill-[var(--color-text-primary)]) render #312f2b. tokens.own_tokens_never_referenced is 137.
findings.before: Two role vocabularies for ink, muted text, brand and border
findings.after: One role set: keep the semantic layer the components already read (--color-text-primary and friends) and alias the shadcn roles to it
findings.why: Two sets that nearly agree produce values a hair apart, and nobody knows which one to edit.
findings.root: shadcn roles beside a second semantic colour set

findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size steps 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 with near_duplicates on each pair; 15px is span.text-[15px] (wordmark) and 17px is text-[17px] on the hero chart labels. frameworks.tailwind.arbitrary_value_classes lists text-[14px], text-[15px] and text-[17px]. Font-size declarations are 60% var.
findings.before: Bracketed 14, 15 and 17px beside a tokenised type scale
findings.after: Wordmark and chart labels on the 14 or 16px step
findings.why: Bracketed sizes between steps blur the scale the tokens define.

findings.evidence: theme.semantic_colour_redefined_share is 0.677: the .dark block (317 declarations) leaves 40 semantic colours unredefined, including --background, --foreground, --border, --card and --accent, and declares 30 names only in dark (dark_only_names, such as --background-color-border-brand).
findings.before: Dark mode redefines one of the two role sets
findings.after: Redefine the single remaining role set in dark, with the same names as light
findings.why: The shadcn roles may keep light values in dark mode unless they alias the other set.

findings.where: headings, body and footer text, eyebrows, borders; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_text.near_duplicates: #32302c (17, h1) and #312f2b (10, wordmark), 0.004 OKLab; #575550 (12, hero lead) and #585651 (6, footer links), 0.004; #0a6355 (4, eyebrow) and #0a6154 (1), 0.006. colour_border pairs #d7d4cd (9) and #d6d3cc. The same pairs appear at 375.
findings.before: Four pairs of colours one step apart doing one job each
findings.after: One ink, one muted, one brand green and one border token
findings.why: Same-job text in two values is the visible trace of the parallel sets.

strengths: One card radius (12px) and pills only, 100% on a token at both widths.
Colour and spacing declarations are about 91% var().
not_investigated: The dark theme was read from the stylesheet only; whether the shadcn roles alias the second set was not confirmed.
Fonts: 4 requests were blocked by the capture network; sizes were read from computed styles.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade with an Operate tool behind it (career guidance landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
